brief: Golden noodles drift lazily in a thick, glossy sauce that coats every strand. The background strictly cycles through a spectrum of warm yellow hues, shifting slowly from pale cream to deep amber over time. No mouse movement or click alters the scene; the animation plays out entirely on its own loop, creating a hypnotic, self-contained dining experience where the only change is the natural flow of color and the gentle wandering of pasta through the rich gravy.
